name: Critical Effects (BC): Rending - Body
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-20 (p. 254). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: If the target wears no armour on this location, 1 level of Fatigue. If armoured, no effect.
1 level of Fatigue. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or Stunned for 1 round.
Stunned for 1 round. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or suffer Blood Loss.
Blood Loss and Stunned for 1 round.
[[1d10]] Toughness Damage and Blood Loss. Anyone moving through the pool of blood must pass an Agility Test or fall Prone.
Knocked Prone, [[1d10]] Toughness Damage and Blood Loss.

[[1d5]] permanent Toughness Damage and Blood Loss. The target may hold the wound closed with one arm until a successful Medicae Test binds it, or fight on with a 20% chance each turn of taking a further [[2d10]] Damage.
Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or die. On a success: [[1d10]] permanent Toughness Damage, Stunned for 1 round and Blood Loss.
The target dies. For the rest of the fight, anyone moving within 4 metres of the corpse must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility Test or fall Prone.
